title: Add failing tests that replay skips an after-digest target, applies a before-digest target, rejects any other digest as a conflict, and repeats an already committed completion without changing bytes or duplicating checkbox, scribe, or attempt history. Implement compare-and-apply recovery, allow a matching finalized attempt with an unfinished journal to resume, and verify with `node --test test/finalization-recovery.test.mjs`.
